label: Aruba CX 8360-32Y4C
description: Aruba CX 8360-32Y4C - 32x 25G SFP28 plus 4x 100G QSFP28 uplinks. L3 aggregation/core switch.
notes: HPE Aruba Networking CX 8360 v2 family. I/O census from the QuickSpecs Technical Specifications table, row I/O ports and slots (https://www.hpe.com/us/en/collaterals/collateral.a50004274enw.html, version 23, 15 June 2026), cross-read against the family datasheet a50002121enw Product capabilities list (https://www.hpe.com/psnow/downloadDoc/HPE%20Networking%20CX8360%20Switch%20Series-a50002121enw.pdf?id=a50002121enw). AOS-CX numbers the front panel sequentially from 1/1/1, so QSFP+/QSFP28 cages continue the SFP group. All QSFP ports except those on the 48XT4C support optional 4x10G/4x25G breakout cables - a transceiver mode on the cage, not extra front-panel ports, so no extra interfaces are modelled. 50G is supported on the 16Y2C, 32Y4C and 48Y6C (QuickSpecs Key Features) but is not modelled: the catalogue port shapes stop at each cage native speed. This model: "28 ports of 1GbE/10GbE/25GbE (SFP/SFP+/SFP28) / 4 ports of 10GbE/25GbE (SFP+/SFP28) with MACsec / 4 ports of 40GbE/100GbE (QSFP+/QSFP28)" - the 28 plain plus 4 MACsec cages are the 32 Y ports, so the template count stays 32 and nothing extra is drawn. Switching capacity 2.4 Tbps, 2 PSUs, 3 fans. SKUs: JL700C front-to-back, JL701C back-to-front, base switch JL717C.
